profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Cloud & Distributed Systems | AWS | FinTech | AI-Augmented Development (DevGPT Cline, Copilot)
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building cloud-native, event-driven platforms within the finance industry. At J.P. Morgan, I led major modernization efforts across global advisory platforms—including a PaaS billing system enabling $200M+ in quarterly revenue and an ERISA compliance engine analyzing 700,000+ accounts monthly.

My work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, automation, and cloud architecture (AWS, Terraform, Kafka, Oracle, Snowflake). I’m passionate about improving engineering velocity and team productivity—both through strong technical leadership and through AI-augmented development practices.

I leverage DevGPT Cline, GitHub Copilot, and prompt engineering to accelerate planning, deepen system understanding, modernize legacy workflows, and generate high-quality utilities and automation tools. I enjoy mentoring engineers, simplifying complex architectures, and driving initiatives that make engineering teams faster, stronger, and more scalable.

Always open to connecting with teams building cloud platforms, fintech systems, or AI-driven engineering experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead design, development, and maintenance of a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) billing system supporting J.P. Morgan’s Personal and Private Client Advisors, enabling over $15M in quarterly revenue and serving a global advisor base spanning Geneva, Singapore, and U.S. markets.
Engineered a serverless data movement architecture using AWS Lambda, Kafka, and Oracle, ensuring real-time client data synchronization across secure private cloud environments while maintaining strict compliance with financial advisory billing regulations.
Migrated and modernized the ERISA Retirement Account compliance system, analyzing 700,000+ accounts in AWS S3, automating calculation of $2.4M+ in monthly fee rebates, and delivering Python Pandas-driven reports for advisor insights.
Designed and implemented automation of manual operations, replacing legacy Java Spring CRON jobs with modern API microservices to streamline daily and month-end reporting tasks and integrate with data warehouses such as Snowflake, reducing manual effort and operational risk.
Architected cloud-native solutions across GAIA (private cloud) and AWS, leveraging Terraform, Bitbucket, and the Jules CI/CD pipeline to ensure secure, consistent, version-controlled infrastructure deployments.
Integrated monitoring and observability using AWS CloudWatch, SQS, SNS, and Splunk, improving system reliability and real-time alerting for global operations.
Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to consult on cloud architecture best practices, influencing proof-of-concept projects across the firm.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained Java Bean components to conform to SOAP and RESTful API responses from 31 internal microservices. Utilized web services to support UI for Administration Banking Tool.

Assisted with creating cloud migration strategies and refactoring monolithic application into Dockerized microservices orchestrated through Kubernetes. 

Performed troubleshooting and information gathering through creation of Splunk search queries to assist as a member of Kanban Development support team.

Developed and enhanced automate test scripts using Cucumber framework and Selenium Web Driver through Behavior Driven Development.

Facilitated Angular application testing using Karma and Jasmine for departments first cloud-based application.

Participated in scrum meetings like daily stand-ups, story acceptance and sprint planning.
positions.insights: Java Development, Platform as a Service (PAAS) and +2 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Decreased overall data dependency of legacy system by 33% through data migration of 5277 data records and internally tagging 1507 records as obsolete.
Trained and mentored junior developers and engineers, teaching skills in Java Spring and React and working to improve overall team performance.
Oversaw deployment of 29 Cloud Foundry instances, configured with CI/CD pipelines composing of Jules, Active Directory Federation Services, Gaia, and ID Anywhere.
Implemented Client Setup Alert feature which boosted visibility in operation errors by 18% over 30-day span post release.
Codebase integration of 29 Java Spring Boot microservices and 3 React Web applications, using Kafka as communication medium.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Directs network response team's reconfiguration of port security to restore LAN access to 238 clients.
Head of IT revamp for $36M Inventory Control System, installed 40 Windows desktop clients during system upgrade.
Information Assurance Officer charged with sensitive network data leakage response.
Account Manager for IT assets; maintained positive control and inventory of a $202K account.
Evaluate the organizations technology use and needs; provide hardware and software recommendations.

positions.title: Cargo Manager
positions.description: Provided direct supervision of 57 employees executing cargo preparation for Operation Inherent Resolve

positions.title: Passenger Service Agent
positions.description: Led 27 personal in processing 14K passengers on 5K missions. Pioneered Distinguished Visitors support team training. Developed 40 hour training curriculum

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead back-end developer establishing AWS EC2 instance connections to deliver data to end-users using Nodejs RESTful web services.
Integrating cloud base services such as Firebase into existing mobile applications to reduce the workload of the back-end servers by 18%.
Engineer mobile applications using React Native, including project for Dover Air Force Base relaying information to the 10K+ base population.
Compose functional mobile app templates for varies businesses using React Native.
Modify existing software to correct errors, allow it to adapt to new hardware, or to improve its performance.
Develop and direct software system testing and validation procedures, programming, and documentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and development of application programming interface, APIs for client use. Analyze user needs and software requirements to determine feasible designs within time and cost constraints.

projects.title: Food Recommendation App
projects.description:
Food recommendation app which randomly selects restaurants based on user's location
Queries AWS hosted Redis server to supply users the top five restaurant locations within their local area. 
Custom restaurant search queries based on user defined preferences and filter tags.
Built Docker container serving as a Java Spring based back-end API to function as gateway to Yelp API service.
Utilized: Java, Spring Framework, Docker, AWS, Redis, React, React Native, Expo, npm, Redux, Github, Redux

projects.title: Dover Air Force Base Mobile App
projects.description:
• Manned2persondevelopmentteamtodevelopReactNativeapplication.
• Deployedapplicationasinformationhubfor10K+ base personnel.
• Relayed real-time notifications using Expo Push Notification library.
• Employed application analytics to remove underutilized features and increase user
retention by 15%.
• Utilized: React, ReactNative, Expo, npm, Redux, Firebase, Github and Redux-Thunk
